brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said he discussed "eliminating" Iran's regime with US President Trump, according to Al Jazeera English. Netanyahu characterized the conversation as addressing the necessity of toppling Iran's government.

The remarks signal potential alignment between Netanyahu and Trump on Iran policy, though neither leader has detailed what such discussions entail or what concrete steps either country might pursue.
dek: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says he discussed the need to topple Iran’s regime with US President Trump.
title: Netanyahu tells Trump regime change in Iran is necessary
